solar_policy: Reboot removed stopped process; do not restart Solar; epoch05 preserved
existing_mechanism_policy: Weather336 smoke blocked before reboot; preserve 36 completed core and 6 integrated cells; do not change existing source
lag_sign: query[t] versus candidate[t+delta]; positive delta reads a later CANDIDATE PAST index
raw_patch_fallback: demean each patch; unit L2 if patch RMS>1e-8, otherwise zero vector; mean aligned patch cosine
lag_ties: maximum similarity; exact ties by minimum absolute lag, then negative lag
pamr_audit: 2026-11-03 remote utils/models/layers/experiments Python search: no PAMR reference; explicitly defined raw patch fallback used

diagnostic_track.D1_D3: Reuse verified sources; original validation-fixed epsilon results separate from NEW query-boundary-relative sensitivities
diagnostic_track.new_near_epsilon: max(1e-8,fraction*d_oracle10) at fractions .01,.05,.10, all reported; diagnostic future label only
diagnostic_track.D2: C=union(head Top10, mixture Top10); fusion=Rmix-RoracleC; discovery=RoracleC-RoracleSupport; check each Q,C, no clamp
diagnostic_track.D4_sampling: 32 fixed evenly spaced validation and test timestamps, all channels; expand only with explicit coverage status; no performance-based selection
diagnostic_track.D4_full_probe: future-blind canonical model Top100 and Top200 reranking; full bank used for base retrieval; never called exhaustive shift search
diagnostic_track.D4_probe_grid: alpha [0,.01,.03,.1,.3,1], beta [0,.01,.03,.1]; per-channel validation TopR mixture-score std multiplies both terms; recent unshifted last16 MSE divided by per-channel validation median; minimum validation RetMSE, lower alpha/beta ties
diagnostic_track.bootstrap: paired timestamp blocks H/2H/4H, all channels jointly, 2000 seed0, percentile .025/.975; insufficient<4 blocks

softlag_track.training_support_policy: native validation-selected V5 checkpoint for each support; no checkpoint reselection
softlag_track.sample_rule: unique linspace row indices fixed before any test evaluation; original starts/splits/masks saved and hashed
softlag_track.test_policy: only after validation selects epoch; do not evaluate every test epoch
softlag_track.trainable: B1 shared lag bias+alpha; B2 five lag biases+one common alpha; g and patch features detached
softlag_track.init: alpha=0, biases=0; actual canonical B0 score/IDs gate mandatory
softlag_track.teacher: original valid-support z-score negative FutureMSE implementation; import and source-hash audit required before training
softlag_track.activity: std_query/(std_query+train_scale_c) * std_candidate/(std_candidate+train_scale_c); train_scale_c=max(1e-8,median train sampled query std)
softlag_track.optimizer: Adam, lr .01, no weight decay, shared B1/B2 batch order and fixed query batch8; subject only to correctness/resource gate, never test tuning
softlag_track.selection: minimum aggregate validation RetMSE; earlier epoch tie; epoch0 eligible
softlag_track.verdict: PROMISING/NEGATIVE/INCONCLUSIVE; small seed0 sampled pilot, no causal specialization or final performance claim
